other_failure_modes.name: KNN Self-Matching Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: When generating KNN features on the training set, the nearest neighbors model is queried with the training points themselves. This results in the first neighbor always being the point itself (distance 0), which introduces a systemic train-test distribution shift because validation and test sets will not contain this self-match distance of 0.

other_failure_modes.name: Cross-Validation Data Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Global statistics are calculated on the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, slightly compromising the integrity of the out-of-fold validation.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with strong feature engineering, deep learning, and stacking. However, it suffers from a subtle data leakage issue where KNN features query the training set against itself, causing a train-test distribution shift (self-matching). Additionally, there is minor cross-validation leakage from calculating imputation ratios prior to the K-Fold split.
